name: wisp-mcp
description: Manage Wisp Panel game servers through Model Context Protocol: status, files, console, power, backups, databases, and diagnostics.
long_description: A security-focused MCP server for the Wisp game panel Client API. Works with compatible Wisp hosts such as VeryCloud and with game servers including Rust, Minecraft, and others managed by Wisp.

panel_url.title: Wisp panel URL
panel_url.description: Base URL of your Wisp panel, for example https://panel.verycloud.fr

api_token.title: Wisp Client API token
api_token.description: Client API token created in your Wisp account

server_id.title: Default server ID
server_id.description: Optional short Wisp server ID. Leave empty to select a server per tool call.

allow_commands.title: Allow console commands
allow_commands.description: Allow sending console commands to Wisp game servers.

allow_file_writes.title: Allow file changes
allow_file_writes.description: Allow creating, editing, renaming, compressing and changing server files.

allow_power.title: Allow power control
allow_power.description: Allow start, stop and restart power operations.

allow_backups.title: Allow backup changes
allow_backups.description: Allow creating and changing backups. Destructive backup actions still require the destructive switch.

allow_databases.title: Allow database changes
allow_databases.description: Allow database creation and credential operations.

allow_server_settings.title: Allow server settings changes
allow_server_settings.description: Allow supported Wisp server and monitoring setting changes.

allow_destructive.title: Allow destructive operations
allow_destructive.description: Keep disabled unless you explicitly need delete, restore, password rotation, force-kill, or similar operations.
